_comment: Punjab and the two project districts (Ludhiana, Faridkot - kept as separate features since they aren't adjacent) are real administrative polygons from geohacker/india (GADM-derived), simplified for web use - see scripts/fetch_boundaries.py. India's own outline is still the basemap's default (not this file) - swapping in a Survey-of-India-aligned full-claim J&K outline remains an open TODO, see WheatHarvestMap.jsx.
